Are relentless hordes of monsters constantly interrupting your complex GregTech chemical setups? It is time to establish a strict perimeter. By infusing pure alchemical energy into a simple light source, you can craft the Interdiction Torch. This device does not merely illuminate the darkness; it projects a continuous, invisible kinetic force field that aggressively repels any hostile entity attempting to approach. It is the ultimate peace-of-mind upgrade—a mandatory security installation for any serious factory floor where a single rogue Creeper explosion could mean the loss of countless hours of hard work.

Functionally, placing this torch creates a localized exclusion zone that physically pushes away hostile mobs, keeping your work area entirely secure. But its defensive properties are even more impressive than that: the repulsion field is so strong that it will effortlessly deflect incoming projectiles right out of the air. With this torch planted firmly by your side, absolutely no skeleton sniper will ever be able to assassinate our "Great Mr. President." Stand tall, ignore the arrows bouncing off your force field, and continue building your industrial empire in absolute safety!
